production.direction_en: Nixie leads the company beneath bare apple trees. The fruit is still on the branches, but every name board in the orchard is blank.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_ch3_oakhaven (uneasy layer from the start: the name boards are blank) | post: bgm_ch3_oakhaven

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: A village can survive losing a name.

commands.speaker: nixie_vale
commands.text: A person should not have to prove they belong in their own home.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: Then we give the names back.

commands.speaker: fadyme_thought
commands.text: Every year I hid, someone else paid my hours.
